تستغربون (form X)
# تَسْتَغْرِبُونَ (tastaḡribūna) /tas.taɣ.ri.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# تُسْتَغْرَبُونَ (tustaḡrabūna) /tus.taɣ.ra.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
